sources.title: South College catalog and academic calendars

studentCautions.text: The DBA uses quarter credits; do not relabel its 90-credit total as semester credits.
The program advertises six-month subscription terms. One term is a billing period, not a guaranteed time or total price for the degree.
Mastery assessments and a doctoral capstone or dissertation remain required; prior experience does not automatically waive them.
Use South College program policies for this doctorate. Undergraduate alternative-credit acceptance and similarly named institutions do not establish doctoral transfer approval.

ambiguities.text: Official pages disagree on the course count: the overview lists 11 while the program page lists 10. Check the assigned catalog and specialization before constructing the ledger.
The catalog index labels the current catalog 2026-2028, but the detailed DBA catalog could not be retrieved. This packet does not establish the student’s program catalog year or transfer limits.

studentCautions.text: The published transfer ceiling concerns previous college coursework. It does not establish acceptance of 90 Sophia, Study.com, or other alternative credits.
The self-paced page lists $3,500 for six-month access. Total tuition depends on the number of terms and any other charges.
MyPath advances through demonstrated mastery without weekly assignment deadlines; do not describe the instructor-led BBA as the same learning model.
The page states credit quantities without explicitly labeling their unit. Confirm the credit-hour equivalence before combining them with quarter or competency-unit records.

ambiguities.text: The older general-business self-paced URL redirects to the current BBA self-paced page; resolve this verified redirect instead of treating the URLs as different programs.

The indexed CBE catalog describes emphasis options, but direct catalog retrieval returned a verification challenge. Confirm the current admitted catalog and complete requirements before using an emphasis or course ledger.
The program page does not explicitly label the credit unit. Confirm the MyPath credit-hour equivalence before applying rules across different credit systems.

studentCautions.text: Choose course-based or Tempo Learning before assigning a curriculum, transfer rule, or tuition model. Both are online options for an MBA.
The course-based MBA page presents 50 quarter credits; indexed catalog content describes the Tempo MBA as 30 semester credits. These are different scoped ledgers, not interchangeable units.
The tuition handbook lists the Tempo MBA at $3,100 per three-month subscription period. Do not apply course-based per-credit tuition or assume one subscription covers the whole degree.
Graduate transfer choices require MBA-specific approval. Undergraduate ACE acceptance cannot establish an MBA equivalency.

ambiguities.text: The same degree and catalog URLs contain course-based and competency-based sections. This packet intentionally has no numeric degree facts until the student’s learning format is selected.

Detailed Tempo requirements appeared in indexed catalog content but not the rendered accordion text. Retrieve the full relevant catalog section before treating the 30-semester-credit description as a complete reviewed ledger.
The current course-based quarter section applies to students beginning on or after May 27, 2024; older semester-based cohorts need their own catalog check.
